conclusion: All three reproduced candidate-only regression classes are resolved at the final hashes. No remaining blocking finding was observed within the requested narrow scanner changes.

resolved_findings.final_verification: Five literal environment names crossed with backtick and tilde fences: 10/10. Real reference remains at line 4. Markdown fake-LaTeX-begin followed by a real literal environment also passes.

resolved_findings.problem: Dollar or quote delimiters inside already protected partial lines changed surrounding scanner state and hid following prose.
resolved_findings.final_verification: Five protected environments crossed with dollar, ASCII quote and Chinese quote delimiters: 15/15. Three active surrounding spans ignore protected false closers and resume at the correct line.

resolved_findings.problem: The intermediate raw-line LaTeX token scan treated begin commands in inline code or comments as real environments and disabled later fence protection.
resolved_findings.final_verification: Three commented/inline-code fake-begin prefixes crossed with both fence markers: 6/6. Literal percent, next-environment and literal-backtick transition cases also pass.

limitations: This is an independent narrow code review and scanner verification, not an execution of the entire repository release gate or any publication action.
Seven file-writing tests were excluded to preserve the reviewer read-only boundary. An earlier attempt at the full manuscript module had two Temp-permission errors; those are not counted as passing.
No full Markdown or LaTeX parser conformance claim is made; historic unsupported nested containers and custom environments were not expanded.
CR-only masking offsets were checked; an improvement to the pre-existing CR-only location counter is not claimed.
The reviewer wrote only this requested review JSON and did not read the other agents' self-proof files.
